question: ____ was the first Indian to win a medal in Birmingham Commonwealth Games
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanket Sargar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Sanket Sargar** became the first Indian to win a medal at the **2022 Birmingham Commonwealth Games**.

• He achieved this milestone in the **Men's 55 kg weightlifting category**, where he secured the **silver medal**.

• Sargar lifted a total of **248 kg** (113 kg in snatch and 135 kg in clean and jerk).

• He demonstrated tremendous determination despite suffering an injury during his final attempt in the clean and jerk segment.

• This achievement marked the beginning of India's medal tally at the Commonwealth Games 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Birmingham Commonwealth Games 2022:**

• The **22nd edition** of the Commonwealth Games was held from **28 July to 8 August 2022** in Birmingham, England.

• A total of **72 nations** participated in the event, featuring over **5,000 athletes** competing across **19 sports**.

• India sent a contingent of **215 athletes** who participated in **16 disciplines**.

• **Weightlifting in Commonwealth Games:**

• Weightlifting has been a part of the Commonwealth Games since **1950**.

• India has traditionally performed well in weightlifting, with athletes frequently securing medals in various categories.

• Weightlifting events are divided into **snatch** and **clean and jerk** segments, with the total weight lifted determining the winner.

• **Sanket Sargar's Background:**

• Sargar hails from **Sangli district** in Maharashtra, India.

• He started weightlifting at a young age and honed his skills through rigorous training and determination.

• Before the Commonwealth Games, he had won medals at the **National Weightlifting Championships** and other international events.

• **India's Performance in Commonwealth Games 2022:**

• India secured a total of **61 medals** (22 gold, 16 silver, and 23 bronze) in the Birmingham Commonwealth Games.

• The country excelled in sports such as **weightlifting, wrestling, badminton, and table tennis**.

• India finished in the **fourth position** in the overall medal tally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Mirabai Chanu:**

• Mirabai Chanu won the **gold medal** in the **Women's 49 kg weightlifting category** at the 2022 Birmingham Commonwealth Games.

• She is a celebrated Indian weightlifter and an Olympic silver medalist.

• **Other Medalists:**

• **Harjinder Kaur** secured a bronze medal in the **Women's 71 kg weightlifting** category.

• **Vikas Thakur** won the silver medal in the **Men's 96 kg weightlifting** category.

• **India’s Historic Success in Weightlifting:**

• India’s weightlifting success at the Commonwealth Games has been consistent, with the country winning several medals in this discipline since its inception.

• This success is attributed to the dedicated efforts of athletes, coaches, and support staff, as well as government initiatives to promote the sport.
